g.text: click a row to isolate it in the chart
Hidden = request_id in no transcript of the session tree (same rule as utility cost).

svg.text: team view: model → user → branch · private repository: model → branch (no user column) · same period and filters as the chart
Hover a band or a node: cost, share, calls. Branch = the session git branch (logs.git_branch); (unknown) = no git branch recorded. Bands below 0.5 % are drawn at 1 px.

g.text: Progress summary of a running sub-agent
unknown source: raw name + "new" marker (server-side dictionary, FR-17)
click a row to open the session OTEL tab
traces = "no" for sessions recorded by a hook without trace support — charts still work from OTEL logs (FR-19).
Live: polls only while the tab is visible; snapshot re-read every 30 s
Chart read from pre-aggregated cost buckets (5-minute, per root session)

svg.text: KPI: sparkline from the same buckets; ▲▼ = change vs the previous period of equal length (needs kpisPrev in the facts route)
Cost flow: needs flows[] in the facts route; buckets joined to the session logs.git_branch — no hook change
Token sums by type: new kpis fields
